name: India Finsec Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, India FinSec Ltd is in the business of loans and investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
IFL operates in the loan and investment sector and is registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company, with a focus on loans and investments.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.2% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 4.26 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 10.4% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 71.2% of their holding.
